description: This file defines a custom exception class 'NormalizeException' used within the OrangeHRM system's API serializer module. It provides specific static methods to generate exceptions related to model attribute validation and type support issues.

classes.name: NormalizeException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in Exception, providing static methods for common error scenarios in model normalization.

methods.name: notSetRequiredAttributes
methods.description: Creates a NormalizeException indicating that required model attributes are not set.

methods.name: unsupportedType
methods.description: Creates a NormalizeException indicating that an object is not of the expected type, specifying the required type and actual type.
